title: Automotive USB Fuzzing
teaser: Presents an in-vehicle USB kernel fuzzing framework directly connected to production vehicles, discovering zero-days across Volkswagen, Renault, GM, and AGL.

title: Abusing CAN Bus Spec for DoS in Embedded Systems
teaser: Martin Petran explores exploiting edge cases in the CAN bus protocol specification and message metadata fields to induce denial-of-service across embedded ECUs.

title: A SSLippery Slope: Unraveling Hidden Dangers of Certificate Misuse
teaser: Bill Demirkapi uncovers systemic validation flaws in digital signature implementations, allowing attackers to repurpose incompatible certificates to sign untrusted code.

title: VDA Shenanigans: Attacking & Defending the Truck Part that Gets Left Behind
teaser: Wyatt Ford and Alex Reuter investigate security weaknesses in Vehicle Diagnostic Adapters (VDAs) used on heavy commercial trucks, exploring firmware updates and attack surfaces.

title: What 10 Years of Drive Stats Data Can Tell Us
teaser: Andy Klein presents a decade of longitudinal Backblaze Drive Stats data, analyzing failure metrics, lifetime telemetry, and reliability trends across enterprise storage drives.

title: What Is a GRC Hacker?
teaser: Allen Baranov explores how the hacker mindset can be applied to Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to improve security culture and risk assessments.

title: Ghost on the Wire
teaser: hoodiepony discusses digital privacy, operational security, and network footprint reduction in virtual reality and connected cyberspace.

title: Hey Crypto Bro
teaser: Sam Colaizzi examines cryptocurrency hype, blockchain security pitfalls, and realistic threat models for decentralized systems.

title: Gender-Inclusive Health Information Systems
teaser: Squiddy explores privacy and architectural considerations for designing gender-inclusive health information systems and electronic medical records.

title: VR Workspaces
teaser: datalocaltmp evaluates the security, productivity, and privacy implications of working within virtual reality workspaces and spatial environments.

title: Bootsquad
teaser: Joe Mast highlights grassroots organizing and community mentorship initiatives across DEF CON Groups.

title: The Curse of the Ncurses
teaser: JBO explores the quirks, historical bugs, and text user interface development challenges in ncurses.

title: Taking Down Applications with Logic
teaser: Abhijeet Singh examines business logic flaws and authorization bypasses in web applications that defeat traditional security scanners.

title: DCGVR Village Keynote
teaser: Jayson E. Street delivers the opening keynote for the DEF CON Groups Virtuality (DCGVR) Village.

title: Infinite Money Glitch: Hacking Transit Cards
teaser: Four high school researchers reverse engineer Boston's CharlieCard RFID fare system, uncovering cryptographic flaws and building a portable fare machine.

title: An Audacious Plan to Halt the Internet's Enshittification
teaser: Cory Doctorow analyzes platform decay across Big Tech monopolies and outlines a policy and technical roadmap for interoperability, privacy, and user self-help.

title: Demystifying (and Bypassing) macOS's Background Task Management
teaser: Patrick Wardle dissects macOS Ventura's Background Task Management architecture, releasing open-source tooling while demonstrating trivial evasion techniques.

title: The Internals of Veilid: A New Decentralized Application Framework
teaser: Cult of the Dead Cow introduces Veilid, an open-source Rust-based peer-to-peer framework for building private, metadata-resistant applications without blockchains.

title: Clocks Have Ears: Timing and Browser-Based Local Network Port Scanner
teaser: Demonstrates browser-based internal network port scanning using precise JavaScript timing side-channels to map intranet devices without elevated privileges.

title: Weaponizing Plain Text: ANSI Escape Sequences as a Forensic Nightmare
teaser: STÖK demonstrates how malicious ANSI escape codes can weaponize application logs to deceive incident responders and compromise modern DevOps terminal emulators.

title: Warshopping: Phreaking Smart Shopping Cart Wheels Through RF Sniffing
teaser: Reverse engineers electronic shopping cart containment wheels, capturing ultra-low-frequency and 2.4 GHz RF signals to unlock wheel braking mechanisms.

title: Visual Studio Code is Why I Have Workspace Trust Issues
teaser: Uncovers critical RCE vulnerabilities in Visual Studio Code, demonstrating how malicious repository configurations bypass Workspace Trust protections.

title: Video-Based Cryptanalysis: Extracting Keys from Power LEDs
teaser: Recovers cryptographic keys by analyzing video footage of device power LEDs, using camera rolling shutters to measure CPU power consumption fluctuations.

title: Vacuum Robot Security & Privacy: Prevent Your Robot from Sucking Your Data
teaser: Dennis Giese demonstrates rooting flagship robotic vacuum cleaners across four vendors, exposing cloud telemetry risks and enabling offline open-source control.

title: Unlocking Hidden Powers in Xtensa-Based Qualcomm Wi-Fi Chips
teaser: Extends the Nexmon firmware modification framework to Xtensa-based Qualcomm Wi-Fi chipsets, enabling custom frame injection and security research.

title: Unlocking Doors from Half a Continent Away
teaser: Demonstrates long-distance relay attacks against ISO 14443A and HID SEOS contactless credentials, unlocking a physical door in Ottawa from a stage in Las Vegas.

title: UNConventional Cybercrime: Bad Treaty Becoming Law
teaser: EFF experts analyze the draft UN Cybercrime Treaty, warning of risks to security research, vulnerability disclosure, and global human rights.

title: Turning My Virtual Wallet into a Skimming Device
teaser: Examines hardware and Bluetooth vulnerabilities in low-cost Mobile Point-of-Sale (MPOS) card readers that allow attackers to skim payment credentials.

title: Track the Planet! Mapping IDs & Monitoring Presence in Azure
teaser: Alexander Hagenah details unauthenticated, zero-log user enumeration techniques across Microsoft Azure, Teams, and OneDrive spanning millions of accounts.

title: There Are No Mushroom Clouds in Cyberwar
teaser: Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense Mieke Eoyang debunks nuclear analogies in cyberwarfare, detailing modern Defend Forward strategies and public-private partnerships.

title: Ringhopper: How We Almost Zero-Day'd the World
teaser: Benny Zeltser and Jonathan Lusky detail RingHopper, a multi-vendor UEFI vulnerability allowing user-space attackers to jump directly into System Management Mode (SMM).

title: How Vulns in Global Transportation Payment Systems Cost You
teaser: Omer Attias dissects API vulnerabilities in popular mobile transit payment apps like Moovit, demonstrating fare evasion and passenger PII data leakage.

title: DARPA AI Cyber Challenge Announcement
teaser: DARPA Program Manager Perri Adams and industry leaders announce the AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC) to automate software vulnerability discovery and remediation.

title: The Hackers, The Lawyers, And The Defense Fund
teaser: EFF attorneys and security researchers discuss legal defense strategies and introduce the Security Research Legal Defense Fund for good-faith hackers.

title: The GitHub Actions Worm
teaser: Asi Greenholts demonstrates a proof-of-concept worm propagating through the GitHub Actions ecosystem by compromising interdependent custom actions.

title: TETRA Tour de Force: Jailbreaking Digital Radios & Base Stations for Fun
teaser: Midnight Blue reverse engineers the secret TETRA radio standard, uncovering proprietary cipher flaws and a backdoored encryption algorithm in critical infrastructure.

title: Terminally Owned: 60 Years of Escaping
teaser: David Leadbeater revisits 60 years of terminal escape sequence vulnerabilities, detailing multiple remote code execution flaws across major terminal emulators.

title: Still Vulnerable Out of the Box
teaser: Audits 21 prepaid and 11 unlocked Android smartphones, uncovering privilege escalation, arbitrary file access, and remote command execution in preloaded firmware.

title: Spread Spectrum Techniques for Anti-Drone Evasion
teaser: Explores implementing low-cost frequency-hopping spread spectrum algorithms on DIY and consumer drones to resist RF jamming and anti-drone interception.

title: Spooky Authentication at a Distance
teaser: Tamás Jos presents a post-exploitation technique to proxy Windows authentication protocols remotely without elevated privileges, enabling full domain takeover.

title: SpamChannel: Spoofing Emails from 2M+ Domains
teaser: byt3bl33d3r demonstrates spoofing emails from over two million domains, bypassing SPF and DMARC by exploiting trust architectures between cloud edge services.

title: StackMoonwalk: Advanced Call Stack Tampering and Detection
teaser: Introduces Full Moon and Half Moon call stack spoofing techniques to evade EDR inspection, alongside the Eclipse kernel detection algorithm.

title: Snoop on to Them, as They Snoop on to Us
teaser: Investigates fixed-address Bluetooth Low Energy beacons in law enforcement gear, body cameras, and consumer IoT, demonstrating long-term tracking.

title: Smashing the State Machine: The True Potential of Web Race Conditions
teaser: James Kettle introduces multi-request single-packet race condition techniques, collapsing complex web application state machines within sub-millisecond windows.

title: Small Leaks, Billions of Dollars: Cryptographic Attacks on MPC Wallets
teaser: Demonstrates practical cryptographic key-exfiltration attacks against Multi-Party Computation (MPC) algorithms securing billions in cryptocurrency wallets.

title: Prototype Pollution Leads to Remote Code Execution in Node.js
teaser: Mikhail Shcherbakov and Musard Balliu uncover universal Prototype Pollution gadgets within Node.js core and popular NPM packages, achieving RCE across major applications.

title: Second Breakfast: Implicit & Mutation-Based Serialization Vulns in .NET
teaser: Jonathan Birch demonstrates novel .NET deserialization RCE attacks that bypass standard assumptions, exploiting database drivers and immutable data streams.
